title: Dimension after extension and restriction
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme of finite type over a field $K$. For every
field extension $L/K$, one has $\kundim X_L=\kundim X$. If
$U\hookrightarrow X$ is an open dense immersion, then
$\kundim U=\kundim X$.

proof.text: Apply the existing source theorem topologicalKrullDim_pullback_eq_of_field (the closed source attachment in lean_audit.slopmaster2 of lem-pc-dim-base-change) to the structure map and Spec of algebraMap K L. Its hypotheses are only that both coefficient rings are fields and the structure map is locally of finite type. It gives the entire field-extension clause, including the empty scheme.

For an open immersion j : U → X with dense range, its open image j.opensRange has the subspace topology and is dense. Apply topologicalKrullDim_le_of_dense from lem-weil-pbc-dense-open-dimension-comparison to this open subset of X and the given locally finite type, quasi-compact structure morphism. This gives dim X ≤ dim(j.opensRange). The open embedding identifies U homeomorphically with its range, giving dim(j.opensRange) = dim U.

The open immersion is inducing, so open-subspace dimension monotonicity gives dim U ≤ dim X. Antisymmetry with the preceding inequality proves the dense-open clause. Together with the field-extension equality this proves the conjunction. No nonemptiness assumption was introduced in either clause.
